title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression checks and CI hook for prompt-set quality gating
author: Samira Ahmed
description: Motivation: We want to stop regressions in prompt-set quality from reaching production. This PR introduces a per-prompt regression check and a lightweight CI hook that runs eval-harness prompt sets for changed prompts and fails the job when metrics fall below configured thresholds. Summary: - Add per-prompt metadata and baseline storage for prompt quality metrics (accuracy/ROUGE/semantic-similarity). - Implement comparator logic that computes delta against baseline and flags regressions using configurable thresholds (absolute and relative). - Add a CI runner script (ci/run_prompt_quality_checks.sh) that discovers affected prompt-sets in a PR, runs a cached subset of eval-harness tests, and uploads a summarized report to the PR via GitHub Checks. - Wire the CI hook into the repo-level pipeline (github/workflows/eval-prompt-quality.yml) with a fast-path for small PRs and a full-suite for release branches. - Add documentation and troubleshooting notes in docs/eval-harness/prompt-quality-gating.md. Checklist: - [x] Per-prompt baseline store and schema (JSON + checksums) - [x] Comparator and threshold config (env + per-prompt overrides) - [x] CI discovery and fast-path logic - [x] GitHub Checks integration with human-readable summary and links to detailed artifacts - [x] Unit and integration tests for comparator and CI runner - [x] Docs and runbook Notes on implementation: - Baselines are stored as compressed JSON under infra/eval-baselines/ keyed by prompt-set and model-tag. Baseline updates require an approved change and a --update-baseline flag to the harness to avoid accidental baseline overwrite. - The comparator reports both metric deltas and an aggregated pass/fail signal. The CI step fails only when aggregated signal fails; individual prompt regressions are surfaced in the report for triage. - The CI runner uses cached artifacts and a small evaluation sample by default to keep runtime under 10 minutes for most PRs. - We added a guard that exempts docs-only and test-only changes from running the full suite by detecting changed paths. Testing: - Local unit tests for comparator and baseline loading added under eval-harness/tests/ - Integration CI job tested on feature branch with synthetic regressions; observed correct failure modes and informative check annotations. Rollout: - Feature gated behind repo-level flag EVAL_PROMPT_CI_ENABLED=false; enabled for internal teams initially. - Monitoring: new eval_harness.prompt_quality_check counter and a dashboard row in SLO toolkit. Migration/Notes: - Repo-level workflows updated; please rebase any long-lived feature branches. - Baseline updates must be accompanied by a Linear ticket (ENG-1213) and a short justification in the PR body. Related: ENG-1213, PM-89, SUP-459.

Samira Ahmed (2026-02-12): Reply: missing baselines fall back to 'no baseline' mode which records metrics but doesn't fail the CI. Added fallback behavior to comparator and tests.
Liu Wang (2026-02-14): CI runner looks good; please make sure artifact uploads are size-limited. Also prefer GH Checks summary over comments for noisy output.
Samira Ahmed (2026-02-15): Addressed: added size cap to artifacts and switched to GitHub Checks API for summary. PTAL.
Nadia Ortiz (2026-02-17): Approved after minor doc fixes and clarifications on baseline update process.
notes: This PR introduces infra artifacts (compressed baselines) which increase repo size marginally; infra team is aware. Baseline updates must go through the normal review + Linear ticket process. Enable the feature via EVAL_PROMPT_CI_ENABLED=true in repo settings to opt-in.
